source.fangraphs: leaders/major-league team splits (type=8) bat+pit+fld; month=0 season, month=1 last 7 days; blend=equal-weight avg
source.odds: 4casters MLB orderbook (api.4casters.io); ESPN DraftKings moneylines as fallback
source.kalshi: Kalshi MLB Game Winner markets (api.elections.kalshi.com) volume_fp per side

formulas.kalshiMult: side_volume / other_side_volume (Ticker Tracker Game Winner volume ratio)
formulas.valSpread: Val side spread with odds in [-150, +110]; prefer ±1.5, else closest to -120
formulas.note: Positive diffs / Overall Edge favor the home team. Lower-is-better pitching edges (xFIP, SIERA) are flipped. Edges are recomputed per stats window. SZN + L7 averages season and last-7 team stats equally before diffs/z-scores. Model MLs/Val use grouped factors → runDelta → logistic (not raw overallEdge sum). Money column is Kalshi Game Winner dollar volume per team. Val grades 1u ML + optional 1u spread.
